description: Reminders are TrainRec's notifications on the person's phone. They start at zero: none exist until the person asks their assistant (you) to set one up, so when they ask to be reminded of something, this is how. Adds a reminder, or changes one (give its id and version). Kinds: weigh_in, log_food (optionally one meal), workout (names today's planned workout if there is one) and streak (training weeks in a row, sent only if this week has no workout yet) go at a local time, and each is skipped that day once it is done. goal goes when a daily number is approaching or has reached its target (calories, a macro, or a nutrient with a target), not between 22:00 and 07:00. custom says the person's own words at a time. recap sends the day's calories and protein against their targets and its workout, at a time, every day it is on. Every reminder needs its trigger from the person: a time (their local time, 24-hour HH:MM) for timed kinds, or the amount left for an approaching goal alert. If they didn't say one, or said only "before 9 am", ask them what time; never choose it yourself. At most 20 reminders and 6 notifications a day. It shows in the app under the assistant's name, with Undo. threshold goes once, the first time today's total of a food number goes over an amount the person sets, whatever their target. check goes at a time only if today's total is still under (or over) the amount they set. Both need the whole trigger from the person: the food number, over or under, the amount, and for check a time outside 22:00 to 07:00. If they say "my target", say the number back and use that number. Set one up only when the person asks for it. A workout reminder can be for one day (date) instead of days of the week, for a planned workout: "remind me at 5 before Tuesday's workout". Its time is still the one the person says.

direction.description: As the person says it. threshold: over.

number.description: The food number: kcal, a macro or a nutrient.

value.description: The amount, in the number's unit (kcal, g, mg, ml), as the person says it.

at.description: Local time, HH:MM 24-hour, as the person says it. Required for every kind but goal; ask them if they didn't say.

date.description: workout only: the one day it is for, YYYY-MM-DD, instead of days.

days.description: 1 = Monday to 7 = Sunday. Leave out for every day.

when.description: reached says when calories or a limit is hit or passed, or a goal like protein is met.

within.description: approaching: how much is left when it says so, in the number's unit (kcal, g, mg). Required for approaching; ask the person if they didn't say.

id.description: To change an existing reminder. Leave out to add one.

on.description: Default true. false keeps it but sends nothing.

streak.description: streak only. training_weeks: weeks in a row with a workout; training_days: days in a row with a workout or food logged.

text.description: custom only. What it says, up to 80 characters: "Take creatine".

name: trainrec_set_reminder
title: Set a reminder
